mentions.name: Vistacker
mentions.description: A local-first task and note manager with AI integration, available as a terminal UI app for Mac, Linux, and Windows and as an iOS app. It supports disconnected operation, automatic sync across multiple machines, and optional encryption so the service cannot see user data.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a local first task and note manager with AI integration, both a TUI (mac, linux, windows) and iOS app.

https://vistacker.com - allows disconnected operation, auto sync across multiple machines with optional encryption so the service can’t see your data.
